app.title: pxsig · {project}
app.embedEmpty: No result for this story. Run a check from the toolbar.

decide.title: pxsig: recording a decision
decide.waiting: Waiting for the decision from the Storybook panel.
decide.needsLink: Open the dashboard link from the terminal first: pxsig serve printed it, and pxsig serve --link prints a new one. Then decide in the panel again.
decide.noOpener: This window records decisions from the Storybook panel and closes. Opened on its own, it has nothing to do.

card.noBaseline: No baseline. Approve the first render.
card.recheckTitle: Render and check this entry again

review.pendingReason: New: not rendered yet. Re-check it, then approve its first render.

banner.label: Coverage
banner.repairNote: Safe repairs register new stories and render them, re-check entries without a usable verdict, and restore baseline images that pass the gate. They do not approve changes or write signatures.
banner.nothing: No issues can be repaired automatically.
banner.firstApprovalNote: Registered entries without a baseline. Nothing is approved automatically.

orphans.one: {count} orphaned baseline. To move it to the store's trash/ folder, run {command} in a terminal.
orphans.other: {count} orphaned baselines. To move them to the store's trash/ folder, run {command} in a terminal.

table.title: Coverage by Component
table.sourceStorybook: Source: Storybook index, {count} stories in scope. Updated {date}.
table.sourceStatic: Source: static scan of story files, {count} stories in scope. Updated {date}.

description.one: {count} of {total} components has stale entries. Highest share first.
description.other: {count} of {total} components have stale entries. Highest share first.

description.one: {count} entry. Select a rendered entry to open it.
description.other: {count} entries. Select a rendered entry to open it.

unregistered.title: Not registered
unregistered.help: In the story index but not in the manifest. Not rendered or checked.

render-error.title: Render error
render-error.help: The last render failed (timeout, missing selector or Storybook error page).

never-checked.title: Never checked
never-checked.help: In the manifest with a signature, but not in the last report.

missing-baseline-image.title: Baseline image missing
missing-baseline-image.help: The signature exists but the baseline image does not, so the baseline cannot be displayed.

legacy-format.title: Legacy baseline format
legacy-format.help: A pre-0.2 .pxsig.json baseline. `pxsig doctor --repair` converts it when the latest render passes the gate.

unbaselined.title: No baseline
unbaselined.help: In the manifest without a signature. The first render needs approval.

orphaned.title: Orphaned
orphaned.help: A signature or baseline image with no matching story.

changed.title: Changed
changed.help: The render differs from the baseline beyond the gate.

flaky.title: Flaky
flaky.help: Failed, then passed on a second render.

stale.title: Stale
stale.help: A source file the entry depends on changed after the last check.

a11y-new.title: New a11y violations
a11y-new.help: axe reports violations that are not on the entry's accepted list.

skipped-unaffected.title: Not run
skipped-unaffected.help: Left out of a partial check because no edited file affects it. Baseline present, no result yet.

drift.title: Pass (minor drift)
drift.help: Within the gate, with SSIM below 1.

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.help: Excluded by configuration: a nonVisual folder, parameters.pxsig.disable or the no-pxsig tag.

storybook-index-broken.title: Storybook index error
storybook-index-broken.help: Storybook responded, but its story index could not be read.

storybook-unreachable.title: Storybook not reachable
storybook-unreachable.help: Stories were read from a static scan of the story files instead.

project-unlisted.title: Project not listed
project-unlisted.help: The project has a config file but is not listed in the workspace.

project-missing.title: Project missing
project-missing.help: A project listed in the workspace has no config file.

version-skew.title: Version mismatch
version-skew.help: Packages in the workspace depend on different pxsig versions.

a11y.title: Rules
a11y.description: axe-core results per rule. New counts entries where the rule is not on the entry's accepted list ({file}); Accepted counts those where it is. Open a rule to see its entries and unaccept one in the inspector.
a11y.empty: No accessibility results in this check. Checks run with {flag} skip the scan.
a11y.howTo: New violations are not on their entry's accepted list. Accept or reject them in an accessibility review, or from the Accessibility panel of an entry in the inspector.
a11y.noneNew: All violations are on their entries' accepted lists. Nothing to approve.

runs.empty: No runs recorded. Each check appends to {file}.

diagnostics.description: Results from the research tools in tools/. Not part of a normal check.

detection.title: Detection Rate by Suite
detection.description: Share of changed renders that failed the gate, per suite. Noise scenarios report false positives.

scenario.gate: Gate: grid {grid}, ≥ {minCells} cells over {threshold}, detail channel {detail}

calibration.gridDescription: {renders} saved renders, {cells}. Whole-image signature only. Rules with a false positive on any noise scenario are excluded.
calibration.detailDescription: Signature gate: {sig} detected. With the detail rule: {best} detected, no false positives. Sweep time {ms} ms.

performance.noResults: The benchmark report has no results. Run {command} again.
performance.renderTitle: Render Time per Story by Page Count
performance.noRender: No render timings. Benchmarks run with {flag} skip them.
performance.threadsDescription: Same renders and verdicts at each thread count. Wall: the whole process. Engine: time reported by the engine.
performance.perCallTitle: Single Compare: CLI Process vs Server
performance.perCallDescription: Median over {count} entries. The CLI starts a process per compare; {command} keeps one engine running.

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: Applied by the CLI, CI, this dashboard and the Storybook addon. A story can override it with parameters.pxsig.gate. The measured values appear under Metrics in the inspector.
gate.wholeImageValue: Fails when SSIM < 0.99, more than 2% of cells differ, or ≥ {minCells} cells differ by more than {threshold}
gate.detailValue: 16 px tiles, 4 px blocks. Fails when ≥ 3 tiles change by more than 32 or gain an edge.

statuses.title: Result Statuses
statuses.changed: Differs from the baseline beyond the gate. Approve or reject.
statuses.new: No baseline. Approving the first render creates one.
statuses.approved: Change accepted. The latest render becomes the baseline.
statuses.rejected: Change marked as unwanted. The baseline is unchanged.
statuses.flaky: Failed, then passed on a second render.
statuses.skipped: Left out of a partial check: no edited file affects it.
statuses.description: The badge on each card and in the inspector header. The card's left edge uses the same colour.

coverage.title: Coverage Statuses
coverage.description: Shown in the Coverage section, and as extra badges on a card when an entry has a coverage issue.

commands.title: Commands
commands.checkChanged: Re-check the entries affected by changes since main
commands.serve: Start the server and this dashboard; re-check on source edits
commands.repair: Plan the safe repairs; add --apply to run them

help.intro: Reference for this dashboard. Each section covers one part of the screen. Point at a row, or move to it with Tab, to see where it appears in the drawing beside it.

tabs.title: Sections
tabs.description: What each section in the top bar is for. Sections that do not fit the bar's width are under its More menu.

overview.meaning: Counts from the latest check, then open items, each with a link or a review session.

review.meaning: Every entry. Filter, group by component, and open one in the inspector. Review sessions start here.

coverage.meaning: Whether each story is registered, rendered, checked and current, per component, with safe repairs.

a11y.meaning: axe violations by rule, new ones first.

runs.meaning: Timing of the latest check and of every past run.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.description: Opens on an entry from Review Stories, a review session or a link. Images on the left, details on the right.

progress.meaning: In a review session: how many entries have a decision, and how many are left.

entry.meaning: The entry ID, its mode, and the reason it failed the gate.

review.meaning: Approve writes the latest render as the baseline. Reject marks the change as unwanted. Undo reverses either; for an approval it restores the previous baseline.

note.meaning: The command to re-check the entry once it is fixed.

modes.meaning: Side by side, swipe, onion skin, pixel diff, or the signature cells the gate compares.

changes.meaning: Steps through the regions where pixels differ.

pixel.meaning: The colour under the pointer in both renders. Requires the local server.

pixelChanges.meaning: Pixels that differ by more than the tolerance, grouped into regions.

metrics.meaning: What the gate measured. A red value is over its limit.

sigs.meaning: The baseline and current signatures and the cell heatmap. Written only for entries that fail the gate; a passing entry shows a note instead.

a11y.meaning: axe violations on this render, each marked New or Accepted. New ones can be accepted or rejected; an accepted one can be unaccepted, which reports it as new again.

files.meaning: Links to the renders and generated files, each opening in a new tab. Copy path copies the file's path in the repository.

a11y.title: Accessibility Checks
a11y.description: How axe results are collected, compared and accepted.

scan.meaning: axe-core runs on every render, right after the screenshot.

accepted.meaning: Each entry's accepted violations, by rule, in a11y.json in the store.

new.meaning: A rule that is not on the entry's accepted list. Counted on the Overview and in the Accessibility section, and marked on the entry's card.

effect.meaning: None. New violations are reported but do not fail the check.

accepting.meaning: Review Stories has an accessibility queue for entries whose only issue is new violations; Accept adds them to the entry's accepted list, Reject marks them for a fix, and Undo reverses either. Accepts and undos are logged in a11y-decisions.ndjson. Approving a visual change also accepts the render's violations, and the Approve button says how many. Unaccept, next to an accepted violation in the inspector, takes it off the list again.

affordance.title: Card Icons
affordance.description: A clickable card shows what it does with one arrow in its top-right corner.

filter.meaning: Filters the current view to what the card counts.

navigate.meaning: Goes somewhere else: another section, the inspector, or a review session.

storybook.title: Opens the story in Storybook with this entry's globals: {globals}
storybook.state: State {state}: set by the check, not by the link

toggles.tilesLabel: Show detail tiles over the limit

review.approveTitle: Use the latest render as the baseline (A)
review.needsLink: Open the dashboard link from the terminal to approve here: pxsig serve printed it, and pxsig serve --link prints a new one.
review.acceptTitle: Add this entry's current violations to its accepted list (A)
review.rejectA11yTitle: Mark the violations for a fix (R)
review.recheckTitle: Render and check this entry again. Never writes a baseline.
review.approveStoryTitle: Approve every entry of this story that waits for a decision: each mode and state, in one batch

inspector.missing: Render not found: {before} or {after}. Run the check again.

pixel.needsServer: Pixel values require the local server ({command}).
pixel.noBaseline: No baseline to compare against yet.
pixel.hover: Hover over the image to read pixel values.

changes.noneOver: No pixel differs by more than {tol}.

stateNew.one: 1 new violation, not on this entry's accepted list. Accept it, or reject it to mark it for a fix.
stateNew.other: {count} new violations, not on this entry's accepted list. Accept them, or reject them to mark them for a fix.

stateNewStatic.one: 1 new violation, not on this entry's accepted list. Accepting it requires the local server ({command}).
stateNewStatic.other: {count} new violations, not on this entry's accepted list. Accepting them requires the local server ({command}).

a11y.stateAccepted: All on this entry's accepted list. Nothing to approve.
a11y.unacceptTitle: Take this rule off the entry's accepted list. It is reported as new until accepted again.

stage.label: Image comparison. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

inspector.rejectedNote: Rejected. Fix the component, then re-run the check:

session.label: Review progress
session.approvedNext: Baselines are written to {store}. Commit them with the change.
session.rejectedNext: Fix the components, then re-run the check:
session.acceptedNext: Added to each entry's accepted list in {file}. Commit it with the change.
session.a11yRejectedNext: Fix the violations, then re-run the check:

artifacts.notWritten: Signature images and the diff page are written only for entries that fail the gate.

inspector.a11yRejectedNote: Violations rejected. Fix them, then re-run the check:
